title: Formula in depth
description: A formula that assembles in depth: every term flies in from far away and out of focus into its place, a band of light passes over it, a cases brace draws and each case lights in turn, and each symbol is tied to its meaning by a line that draws itself. x1 becomes x with a small 1, theta becomes the Greek letter.

props.eq: the formula as plain text, for example A = XW + B (or use cases)
props.lhs: with cases: the left side, for example y
props.terms: up to 4 of {sym, text}: a symbol and what it means
props.title: heading
